label: Heiss 2004
independence: Overlap with older Heiss cohorts and Borghammer controls not established.
method: HRRT ~2.2 mm. Cortical gray-matter lobar aggregation; small structures sampled with MRI-guided spheres.
caution: Older comparison column is Heiss 1984, not another independent dataset. Do not inherit the 2004 nuclear labels for those older values.

label: Heiss 1984
variants: Two estimators in the same seven people
independence: Overlap with Heiss 1985 unknown. Re-tabulation in 2004 reuses these data.
method: CT-guided sampled ROIs. ~8 mm FWHM, 11 mm slices.
role: Candidate historical convergence; native table extraction pending
caution: 22 bilateral/midline territories from 43 side-specific sites. Broad thalamus, mixed midbrain and lentiform are not individual nuclei. Native rates must remain separate from 2004 re-scaled comparisons.

label: Heiss 1985
population: Four men after ~28 hours on duty with little/no sleep
measure: Awake absolute CMRGlc; asleep percentage change
variants: Three nondreamers and one dreamer, kept separate; awake/asleep repeated
independence: States are repeated measurements; subgroups are 3 + 1, not two four-person cohorts. Overlap with 1984 unknown.
method: ~8 mm FWHM, 11 mm slices. Regional procedure refers to Heiss 1984.
caution: Awake is sleep-deprived waking, not a rested normative reference. Whole-brain row is a weighted aggregate of sampled regions.

label: Borghammer 2012
variants: WM; global mean (GM); reference cluster. Same subjects.
independence: Some participants reused from Eggers 2009; overlap of the control subset requires verification. Overlap with Heiss 2004 unknown.
method: HRRT ~2 mm. Histological atlas warped to individual MRI for eight subcortical structures. Two WM reference VOIs.
source: Borghammer_etal_2012_Table2.csv; article Methods, Fig.2 and Table 2; https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1600-0404.2011.01556.x
caution: GM means global mean. Cerebellum is central cerebellar WM. Pooled absolute regional rates cannot be recovered from group ratios. PD rows excluded.

label: Andersen 2022
measure: Paired FDG and UCB-J regional normalized uptake
variants: Two tracers in the same subjects; two age groups. S2 contains age-comparison tests.
independence: Paired tracers, normalization variants and S2 are not independent cohort replications. Cross-paper overlap unverified.
method: Bilateral Hammers N30R83-derived atlas ROIs. Geometric-transfer-matrix partial-volume correction in S1.
role: Paired metabolic–synaptic convergence; additional source, not selected by Heiss authorship
source: Andersen_etal_2022_TableS1.csv; TableS2.csv; reference_tables/region_labels and errata; article Methods
caution: S1: 13 regions with means. HIP occurs only in S2 statistical tests. SN expansion is uncertain. Young CBL row has an unresolved published mean/relative-difference inconsistency.
